issues.title: Ingest Bradley County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $8,943,851 across 27 funds. The largest: County Road ($2,921,322), County General Fund ($2,520,754), Hospital Fund ($1,050,000). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
